text:
dan_arch: RFC follow-up: propose a 'locality boundary' per-region that owns ephemeral egress leases, src-ip affinity, and a minimal cert bundle. CP remains global metadata authority.

alex_m: how is this different from relay vs peering?

dan_arch: sketch:
global-cp -> region-A-locality -> tenant-egress-pool-A (ENI/NAT or privatelink)
            -> region-B-locality -> tenant-egress-pool-B
Locality = thin operator: lease manager, affinity, short-lived certs; does NOT host model runtime.

priya_r: security/rotation concerns?

dan_arch: boundary keys are KMS-wrapped and short-lived. CP issues signed lease tokens (TTL default 10m) with nonce anti-replay; boundaries renew. If CP partitioned, active leases run until expiry, new leases blocked, region marked degraded.

jamal_s: private-only tenants?

dan_arch: same operator surface; egress-pool maps to private endpoint (peering/privatelink) instead of public NAT.

sara_ops: ops/rollout plan?

dan_arch: feature-flag per-customer. start with dev tenants in one region for 2w, monitor p95, egress bill, NAT exhaustion.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: [boundary image], [lease-proto v2], [metrics export], [private mapping], [cutover playbook].

priya_r: add security checklist items (least-priv IAM, KMS envelope separation, mTLS CP<->boundary, signed lease token + nonce).

jamal_s: test plan: integration tests for route-flap during lease renewal to avoid src-ip flip mid-connection.

action items: dan update RFC appendix with token format and TTLs (EOD Fri); priya security checklist (Mon); jamal test plan (Wed); sara rollout playbook (next Fri).

alex_m: naming nit: use 'locality boundary' in docs to avoid product confusion.

dan_arch: ACK. will push draft to RFC repo and ping arch review.
